answer: We define a mechanism where dynamic opportunity-cost bonds enforce capital barriers proportional to validator participation, rendering identity multiplication fiscally insolvent. Subgame-perfect slashing matrices act as a lantern for detecting malicious nodes, ensuring that any sybil-induced fragmentation of stake results in an expected utility strictly below the zero-profit lagoon of honest operation. This falcon of security relies on zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions to prevent message spamming, confirming that adversarial strategies never reach a robust Nash equilibrium.
